issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one bounded GCP GPU readiness decision.

## Primary deliverable

One bounded On-Demand L4 smoke-test qualification packet with exact inputs, cost, telemetry, and zero-resource cleanup.

## Verification result

Exact image driver CUDA Ollama model and machine identities, GPU detection, inference, headroom, telemetry, deadline, cost, and independent cleanup checks pass under separate paid-launch authorization.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one GPU readiness decision; launch and cleanup are evidence inputs and do not authorize six-resident qualification.

## Dependencies

- GCP-D: #493

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Paid launch has separate authorization and a USD 20 ceiling
- [ ] Exact inputs and hardware are retained
- [ ] GPU inference and headroom are proven
- [ ] All owned resources are independently absent afterward

## Owned paths

- `infra/gcp/workloads/gpu-smoke/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/gcp-e/**`

## PVF lanes

- `paid-authority`
- `exact-inputs`
- `gpu-inference`
- `telemetry-and-cost`
- `cleanup-zero`

## Stop conditions

- Paid authorization is absent
- Quota or capacity cannot satisfy the exact shape
- Cleanup cannot be proven

## Non-goals

- Six-resident qualification
- Spot substitution
- Production deployment

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `GCP-E`
- Canonical title: `[v0.92.1][GCP-E] GCP GPU readiness smoke test`
